Short title and commencement

STAMPS (SINDH
AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE XXXV OF
2001
An Ordinance to
amend the Stamp Act, 1899, in its application to the Province of Sindh
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 23rd November, 2001]
No. S.LEGIS:1/(35)2001, dated
23-11-2001. The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby
published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called the Stamp (Sindh Amendment)
Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Addition of Article 6-B Act II of 1899

AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE XXXV OF
2001
An Ordinance to
amend the Stamp Act, 1899, in its application to the Province of Sindh
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 23rd November, 2001]
No. S.LEGIS:1/(35)2001, dated
23-11-2001. The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby
published for general information:--
2. Addition of Article 6-B Act
II of 1899.--In the Stamp Act, 1899, in its application to the Province of
Sindh, in Schedule I--
(i)
After Article 6-A, the following new Article shall be inserted:--
"6-B. Airline Ticket---
(a) Domestic
Twenty five rupees.
(b) International
Two hundred fifty rupees.

Amendment of Article 22-A Act II of 1899
